items.title: oMLX 0.8.3 speeds up Inkling 2 Mini on Apple silicon and adds optimized Hy4 and Hy4-Flash
items.summary: The oMLX local runtime reports Inkling 2 Mini prefill up 21% (1,869 to 2,255 tok/s at 4K) and decode up 13% (86.0 to 96.8 tok/s) on an M5 Max with oQ4e and MTP on. It also ships a more optimized Hy4 and Hy4-Flash implementation, relevant to Mac users running these models locally.

items.title: Hugging Face harness adapters lift Qwen3.8-27B in Pi from 39% to 55% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 with half the tokens
items.summary: Hugging Face describes adapting a model to a specific coding-agent harness, reporting Qwen3.8-27B in the Pi harness improving from 39% to 55% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 while using about half the tokens. Useful for anyone tuning open models for agent harnesses.
